annotations.title: Check a driver log against FMCSA hours of service

description: Find every hours-of-service violation in a commercial driver's duty-status log under 49 CFR Part 395 (11/10-hour driving, 14/15-hour window, 30-minute break, 60/70-hour cycle with 34-hour restart, split sleeper berth, adverse conditions, short-haul, 16-hour exception) and how much time the driver has left. Give status changes in time order with ISO 8601 times that include an offset.

asOf.description: When the log ends ("now"), ISO 8601. Default: the last event.

adverse.description: Adverse driving conditions apply to this driving period (395.1(b)(1))

status.description: OFF, SB (sleeper berth), D (driving) or ON (on duty not driving)

homeTimeZone.description: IANA zone of the home terminal, default America/New_York

priorDailyOnDutyHours.description: On-duty hours for the days before the log, most recent first

name: hos_check
title: Check a driver log against FMCSA hours of service
